Summary: Web Client & Testing
As a job seeker, I want to register and log in so that my data is private to me
Description: Acceptance criteria: Register creates Job Seeker role only; login returns JWT access (30 min) and refresh. SRS: 6.3,6.5

Summary: As the team, we want platform credentials encrypted so plaintext is never stored
Description: Acceptance criteria: AES-256-GCM at rest; raw DB row has no plaintext; tokens write-only in API. SRS: 6.3

Summary: As a job seeker, I want a Pause All button so all automation stops immediately
Description: Acceptance criteria: Endpoint halts scheduled and in-flight runs; state visible in UI. SRS: 6.2

Summary: As a job seeker, I want to accept a legal disclaimer before automation
Description: Acceptance criteria: Acceptance timestamp stored; automation blocked until accepted. SRS: 7

Summary: As an admin, I want to view system-wide automation logs
Description: Acceptance criteria: Only admin role gets 200; job seeker gets 403. SRS: 6.5

Summary: As the team, we want a Jenkins CI/CD pipeline so every PR is built and tested
Description: Acceptance criteria: Pytest + coverage on each PR; merge needs green build and 1 review; deploy on merge. SRS: Guidelines

Summary: As the team, we want SonarQube static analysis on every build
Description: Acceptance criteria: Quality gate fails build on new critical issues or coverage below 80%. SRS: Guidelines

Summary: As the team, we want Docker Compose for Postgres, Redis and workers
Description: Acceptance criteria: One command starts all services. SRS: 2.4

Summary: As a job seeker, I want to upload my resume (PDF/DOCX ≤5 MB)
Description: Acceptance criteria: Valid files accepted; wrong type or >5 MB rejected with message. SRS: REQ-1

Summary: As a job seeker, I want my skills, experience, qualification and roles extracted
Description: Acceptance criteria: pdfplumber/python-docx + spaCy extract fields in Appendix B layout. SRS: REQ-2

Summary: As a job seeker, I want to review and edit my extracted profile
Description: Acceptance criteria: Every field editable; edits used in later matching. SRS: REQ-3

Summary: As a job seeker, I want suggestions to optimise my profile for my target roles
Description: Acceptance criteria: Lists keywords common in target postings that are missing from my resume, plus headline/summary suggestions. SRS: Scope

Summary: As a job seeker, I want a clear error for scanned resumes
Description: Acceptance criteria: Image-only PDFs rejected with prompt to upload text resume. SRS: REQ-4

Summary: As a job seeker, I want to choose LinkedIn, X and/or Naukri as sources
Description: Acceptance criteria: Only selected connectors queried. SRS: REQ-5

Summary: As a job seeker, I want postings ranked by relevance
Description: Acceptance criteria: Weighted keyword score 0–100; feed sorted descending. SRS: REQ-6

Summary: As a job seeker, I want duplicate postings hidden
Description: Acceptance criteria: Same role/company across platforms or runs shown once. SRS: REQ-7

Summary: As a job seeker, I want to filter the feed
Description: Acceptance criteria: Filter by platform, location, min score, recency. SRS: REQ-8

Summary: As a developer, I want an X API adapter using Tweepy
Description: Acceptance criteria: Searches #hiring/#jobs posts within API v2 limits; mocked tests. SRS: 3.2

Summary: As a developer, I want a job listing collector for public LinkedIn and Naukri listings
Description: Acceptance criteria: Read-only, rate-limited collection; tested against recorded fixtures. SRS: 3.2

Summary: As a job seeker, I want an apply kit (tailored resume, cover letter, answers) for each posting
Description: Acceptance criteria: Kit generated from profile and posting; downloadable and copyable. SRS: REQ-9

Summary: As a job seeker, I want assisted apply for LinkedIn and Naukri postings
Description: Acceptance criteria: Original posting opens with apply kit; I can mark it Applied and it is tracked. SRS: Design update

Summary: As a job seeker, I want auto-apply on company career portals (Greenhouse/Lever)
Description: Acceptance criteria: ATS adapter fills and submits the form after confirmation; result recorded. SRS: REQ-9

Summary: As a job seeker, I want to email my application when a post asks for a CV
Description: Acceptance criteria: Personalised email with tailored resume sent from my mailbox after confirmation. SRS: REQ-9

Summary: As a job seeker, I want to confirm before anything is submitted
Description: Acceptance criteria: Review modal required unless Full-Auto enabled for platform. SRS: REQ-10

Summary: As a job seeker, I want a daily application cap per platform
Description: Acceptance criteria: Default 20/day, configurable; excess blocked. SRS: REQ-11

Summary: As a job seeker, I want every attempt recorded
Description: Acceptance criteria: Application row with timestamp and status for success/failure/CAPTCHA. SRS: REQ-12

Summary: As a job seeker, I want CAPTCHAs to pause automation and notify me
Description: Acceptance criteria: Session paused; status Manual Review Required; notification sent. SRS: REQ-13

Summary: As a job seeker, I want recruiter suggestions and a connection strategy for a posting
Description: Acceptance criteria: Recruiters listed with why to connect and best channel (LinkedIn note or X message). SRS: REQ-14

Summary: As a job seeker, I want a personalised, editable outreach message
Description: Acceptance criteria: Template references posting and my skills; editable before send. SRS: REQ-15

Summary: As a job seeker, I want outreach caps
Description: Acceptance criteria: Default 15/day per platform; LinkedIn notes are sent by me via opened profile, X messages via API. SRS: REQ-16

Summary: As a job seeker, I want identical bulk messages blocked
Description: Acceptance criteria: Same text to >1 recipient rejected. SRS: REQ-17

Summary: As a job seeker, I want daily or weekly scheduled runs
Description: Acceptance criteria: Celery beat schedule created and executed. SRS: REQ-18

Summary: As the system, I want to defer actions at 90% of a rate limit
Description: Acceptance criteria: Per-platform window counter; actions deferred at 90%. SRS: REQ-19

Summary: As a job seeker, I want a log of each scheduled run
Description: Acceptance criteria: Postings found, applications, errors shown per run. SRS: REQ-20

Summary: As a job seeker, I want counts by platform and status for a date range
Description: Acceptance criteria: Dashboard API returns correct aggregates. SRS: REQ-21

Summary: As a job seeker, I want to update an application's status manually
Description: Acceptance criteria: Status change saved with history. SRS: REQ-22

Summary: As a job seeker, I want my response rate
Description: Acceptance criteria: Interviews or replies ÷ applications, overall and per platform. SRS: REQ-23

Summary: As a job seeker, I want to export my history as CSV
Description: Acceptance criteria: CSV has Appendix B report columns. SRS: REQ-24

Summary: As a job seeker, I want to see which resume keywords get the most responses
Description: Acceptance criteria: Keyword-yield chart from application outcomes. SRS: Scope

Summary: As a job seeker, I want email/in-app notifications
Description: Acceptance criteria: New matches, run results and status changes notified. SRS: 2.2

Summary: As a job seeker, I want a clean web client for all screens
Description: Acceptance criteria: Upload, profile, feed, review modal, outreach, dashboard; 360 px responsive; WCAG AA. SRS: 3.1

Summary: As a new user, I want to reach the job feed within 3 screens
Description: Acceptance criteria: Usability test passes. SRS: 6.4

Summary: As the team, we want performance and load tests
Description: Acceptance criteria: Search ≤30 s; dashboard ≤3 s; 50 users with Locust. SRS: 6.1

Summary: As the team, we want system and security testing completed
Description: Acceptance criteria: All High test cases pass; ZAP scan clean; RTM updated. SRS: 6.3,6.4
